title: glue
summary: Current Benilla's glue module is the shared pre-world vocabulary: client-data art, byte-derived backdrop splitting/fitting, true SrcAlpha/One ADD overlays, outlined text, fields/caret/selection, button states, arrows, checkbox and scrollbars. MSUI supplies the connected desktop equivalents through GlueScene, GlueBooth, WowSkin and its dedicated GlueAdditive GL pass, with rule-owned create/select/login geometry. The current AddOns-only art inventory is intentionally not imported without an addon/Lua consumer; that conditional product gap is tracked under systems/char_select. Observable screens remain judged under systems/login, systems/char_select and systems/char_create.

openItems.text: Reconcile the evolved shared glue module, including true additive highlights, backdrop fitting, field/button vocabulary and AddOns-only art, against MSUI's desktop consumers.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: Confirmed connected desktop support is present: true SrcAlpha/One GL overlays, backdrop laws, outlined text, field/button states, arrows, checkbox, scrollbars and current delete-dialog art. AddOns-only inventory remains gated with its absent consumer under systems/char_select.
